_meta.notes: Bardic Patronage class-bucket (Bard-only). Contains the Bard-specific class-power activities: passive Chronicles of Battle aura (hireling_inspiration L5+) and active Solicit Followers (hall L9+). Per Q14 [RESOLVED 2026-05-11], the prior 'Bardic variant of Garrison Training' model is replaced by this standalone class-bucket. Bard troop-training capability (if they take Manual of Arms proficiency) flows through the Garrison sub-tab — NOT here.

param_schema.wage_offered_gp: int (optional; default standard mercenary wages per troop type)

activities.effect_summary: Recruits 1d4+1 × 10 0-level mercenaries + 1d6 1st-3rd-level bards into the ruler's service. Hire requires standard mercenary wages.

Passive ability: bard's presence grants +1 morale to hired henchmen and mercenaries when the bard is in the same hex/army. Stacks with Charisma + proficiency morale bonuses. NOT a launchable activity — applies automatically when the bard is co-located with eligible units.
